title: senecio crispus
intro: Senecio crispus, commonly known as Ragwort, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Senecio crispus include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it useful for soothing coughs and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of Senecio crispus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
